changelog:
- Genuine Editorial Images for Trending Pulse: Delivers authentic, high-resolution news photographs for every news story via BBC News Media RSS feeds and media enclosure parsers.
- Visual & Video Discovery Hub Glitch Elimination: Fixed masonry jitter, layout reflow, and UI freeze with instant batch rendering, responsive 540x810 image thumbnails, and asynchronous online wallpaper fetching.
- Real Music Player Controls: Upgraded bottom mini-player and home screen Now Playing card with -10s rewind, +10s fast forward, previous track, next track, and an interactive draggable progress scrubber with mm:ss / mm:ss timestamps.
- Fox News Anti-Adblock Defusal: Cleanly defused intrusive 'Welcome to Fox News' blocker modals, restored full page scrolling, and stubbed FNC ad blocker probes.
- X (Twitter) React Virtualizer Protection: Prevented React render crashes on x.com by eliminating destructive height mutations on cellInnerDiv and exempting X from cosmetic ad CSS.
- Retained pure Android System WebView footprint (17.4 MB).
